label.description: The label for the input field, which provides a clear and concise description of the expected input.

id.description: A unique identifier for the input field, which can be used to associate the label with the input element and for accessibility purposes.

placeholder.description: Text displayed inside the input field when it is empty, providing a hint to the user about the expected input.

error.description: An error message that is displayed when the input value is invalid, providing feedback to the user about what went wrong and how to correct it.

success.description: A success message that is displayed when the input value is valid, providing positive feedback to the user and confirming that their input has been accepted.

disabled.description: A boolean that determines whether the input field is disabled, preventing user interaction and indicating that the field is not currently available for input.

characterCount.description: An object that defines the character count settings for the input field, including the maximum number of characters allowed and the message to display explaining the requirement.

hint.description: Hint text to provide additional guidance

onChange.description: JavaScript function to call when the input value changes

onBlur.description: JavaScript function to call when the input loses focus

textArea.description: A boolean that determines whether the input field is a text area, allowing for multi-line input.

required.description: A boolean that indicates whether the input field is required, meaning that the user must provide a value before submitting the form.

className.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the input field.

style.description: Inline styles to apply to the input field.
